title: Rate limiter Redis connection timeout causing 500s

error_signal.message: vocator-backend Error: ETIMEDOUT getRateLimitRedisClient connection timed out in unified-rate-limiter middleware

ground_truth.root_cause_description: Rate limiter Redis client connection times out. All requests get 500 because rate limiter fails closed instead of open.
ground_truth.fix_description: Add connection timeout handling - fail open (allow request) when Redis is unreachable
